name: germany_undergrad_options_review
description: Discovery interview to understand Adrian’s undergraduate study options in Germany and the decision factors guiding his choice. The outcome is a clarified shortlist, prioritized criteria, light feasibility flags, and immediate research tasks.

sections.label: Student Background and Objectives
sections.description: Capture Adrian’s academic record, language levels, target intake, and long‑term aims that bound feasible study options.

sections.label: Fields of Study and Program Features
sections.description: Record target majors/fields and must‑have program characteristics (e.g., English- vs. German‑taught, applied vs. research focus, dual study, accreditation, class size).

sections.label: University Options and Rationale
sections.description: List specific German universities/programs under consideration with reasons for interest, initial pros/cons, and fit notes.

sections.label: Decision Criteria and Preferences
sections.description: Elicit and prioritize the factors driving the decision; mark must‑haves vs. nice‑to‑haves and assign relative importance/weights.

sections.label: Feasibility Snapshot (Light)
sections.description: For each option, note quick feasibility flags: eligibility route hints (direct/Studienkolleg), needed tests (e.g., TestDaF/IELTS/TestAS), current language readiness, ballpark costs, and any clear showstoppers.

sections.label: Comparative Evaluation and Preference Order
sections.description: Synthesize how shortlisted options score against top criteria and record a tentative ranking with key justifications and trade‑offs.

sections.label: Research Tasks and Next Steps
sections.description: Define focused follow‑ups to inform the decision (e.g., verify admissions route, confirm program details, check housing/costs), with owners and near‑term due dates.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Rapport and Context
phases.goal: Build rapport, confirm meeting goals, and capture a concise snapshot of Adrian’s background and aims.

phases.label: Options Discovery
phases.goal: Surface fields of interest and assemble a concrete list of universities/programs Adrian is considering.

phases.label: Criteria and Comparative Evaluation
phases.goal: Clarify and prioritize decision criteria, perform a light feasibility check, and compare shortlisted options against the criteria.

phases.label: Wrap‑up and Next Steps
phases.goal: Confirm immediate research tasks, owners, and timing to move the decision forward; recap tentative preference.
